## 1. Documentation and data preparation
```{r, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
#The purpose of this round is to take out a few more variables that are not that useful (don't vary much across clusters), or are highly correlated, so that we can re-run the model to particularly see how 4-class model performs (e.g. will it get mre stale, will it land in solutions that gives good differentiation among segments, etc.). Will update this list of variables on the excel out of script 7 (sheet = 'final_var_r4'). Here we keep both work.seasonal and wd.ownincome.cat
#So at this stage, we are particularly interest in comparing k=3 vs k=4, will run k=2:4 only.
```

Data preparation for LCA
```{r}
#recode for LCA, recode those that are actually binary but has characters (string) (or not numeric) to (0,1)
subset_var <- var[var$f.var.name %in% pca.var, c("f.var.name", "var.type")]
#print(subset_var) #for those binary and already numeric, it is good. Need to convert insurance.cov.cat1 and hh.toilet.flush which are actually binary but character in script 4 to numeric binary.
dhs.seg$insurance.cov.cat1 <- ifelse(dhs.seg$insurance.cov.cat1 == "EPM coverage",1,0) 
#table(dhs.seg$insurance.cov.cat1)
dhs.seg$hh.toilet.flush <- ifelse(dhs.seg$hh.toilet.flush == "flush toilet",1,0)
#table(dhs.seg$hh.toilet.flush)

ord.var <- subset_var$f.var.name[subset_var$var.type=='ordinal']
bin.var <- subset_var$f.var.name[subset_var$var.type=='binary']
cat.var <- subset_var$f.var.name[subset_var$var.type=='categorical']

#ord.var #1 var
#bin.var #12 var
#cat.var #6 var
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
## For ordinal re-categorize to start at 1
#table(dhs.seg$wealth.index.ur.ord) ## but the only ordinal variable here already starts from 1, so no need to recode it. The code below is just for printing the tables.
for (var_name in ord.var) {
  cat("\nVariable:", var_name, "\n")
  print(table(dhs.seg[,var_name]))
}

## setting binary to be 1/2
for (var_name in bin.var) {
  dhs.seg[,var_name] <- ifelse(dhs.seg[,var_name] == 0, 1, 2)
  cat("\nVariable:", var_name, "\n")
  print(table(dhs.seg[,var_name]))
}

## setting nominal (categorical) to be coded as 1,2, (here they are all character, no factor...
for (var_name in cat.var) {
  dhs.seg[,var_name] <- as.numeric(as.factor(dhs.seg[,var_name]))
  cat("\nVariable:", var_name, "\n")
  print(table(dhs.seg[, var_name]))
}
#now we have converted all 19 vars properly to integer for LCA
```

### 2.1. Model, statistics, distribution
```{r}
sink("round4_rural.txt")
f <- cbind(ed.lev.cat1,early.cohab.19, marr.cohab, media.sum.2plus, husb.ed.mtprim, wd.ownincome.cat, highestyearsedinHH.7plus, num.under15.2plus, work.seasonal, water.cat, wealth.index.ur.ord, hh.watpur.appr, hh.toilet.flush, med.distance, disc.fp.yn, insurance.cov.cat1, vehic.index, hh.land)~1

rural_class_comp <- data.frame('k' = 2:4, 'BIC' = numeric(3), 'AIC' = numeric(3), 'Chisq' = numeric(3), 'llh' = numeric(3), 'iter' = numeric(3))
rural_pred_class <- list()

lca_results <- list()
for (i in 1:3) {
  print(i)
  cat("\nRunning model with", i + 1, "classes...\n")
  res <- tryCatch({
    poLCA(f, dhs.seg_reform_rural, nclass = (i + 1), maxiter = 5000, tol = 1e-7, nrep = 50, verbose = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("An error occurred: ", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })

  lca_results[[i]] <- res
  
  if (is.null(res)) {
    cat("The poLCA function did not return results for", i + 1, "classes.\n")
    rural_class_comp[rural_class_comp$k == (i + 1), ] <- c((i + 1), NA, NA, NA, NA, NA)
    next
  }

  rural_class_comp[rural_class_comp$k == (i + 1), ] <- c((i + 1), res$bic %||% NA, res$aic %||% NA, res$Chisq %||% NA, res$llik %||% NA, res$numiter %||% NA)

  if (!is.null(res$predclass)) {
    dhs.seg_rural4$cluster <- res$predclass
    dhs.seg_reform_rural$cluster <- res$predclass
    names(dhs.seg_rural4)[names(dhs.seg_rural4)=='cluster'] <- paste0('cluster_k',(i+1))
    names(dhs.seg_reform_rural)[names(dhs.seg_reform_rural)=='cluster'] <- paste0('cluster_k',(i+1))
  } else {
    warning("Model with", i + 1, "classes did not return class memberships.")
  }
}

sink()
print(rural_class_comp)  
```

```{r}
rural.dist <- dhs.seg_reform_rural %>%
  select(cluster_k2,cluster_k3,cluster_k4) %>%
  gather(class_num, "value", 1:3) %>% 
  group_by(class_num,value) %>%

ggplot(rural.dist, aes(x = class_num, y = perc, fill = as.factor(value))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(perc, "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Cluster Number", y = "Percentage", fill = "Value", title = "Distribution of segment for k-class") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
# Define function
generate_heatmap <- function(data, cluster_var_name) {
  
  data_modified <- data %>%
    select(c(bin.var), .data[[cluster_var_name]]) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(bin.var), ~ifelse(. == 2, 1, 0), .names = "prop_{.col}")) %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_var_name]]) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("prop_"), mean))
  
  custom_labels <- c(
  "marr.cohab" = "With partner",
  "early.cohab.19" = "Early marriage or cohabitation",
  "media.sum.2plus" = "Use 2+ media sources",
  "num.under15.2plus" = "With 2+ children U15",
  "hh.kidwom.rat.2plus" = "Ratio of U5 to women >=2",
  "husb.ed.mtprim" = "Partner edu more than primary",
  "highestyearsedinHH.7plus" = "7+ years of edu for HH",
  "hh.watpur.appr" = "Use water purify method",
  "hh.toilet.flush" = "Use flush toilet",
  "med.distance" = "Distance is a big problem",
  "med.alone" = "Going alone is a big problem",
  "med.permis" = "Getting permision is a big problem",
  "disc.fp.yn" = "Discuss FP with someone",
  "insurance.cov.cat1" = "Coverged by EPM insurance",
  "hh.land" = "Own land for agriculture"
)
  
  df_long <- data_modified %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("prop_"), names_to = "var.label", values_to = "prop") %>%
    mutate(var.label = str_remove(var.label, "prop_"),
           label = ifelse(var.label %in% names(custom_labels), custom_labels[var.label], var.label),
           label_percent = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1))
  df_long <- merge(df_long, var, by.x = "var.label", by.y = "f.var.name")
  
  df_long$category <- gsub("Woman and her past experiences", "Woman and her\npast experiences", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Household relationships", "Household\nrelationships", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Household economics and living conditions", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Health mental models", "Health mental\nmodels", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Social support", "Social\nsupport", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Human and natural systems", "H&N\nsystem", df_long$category)

  df_long$category <- factor(df_long$category, 
                    levels = c("Woman and her\npast experiences", "Household\nrelationships", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", "Health mental\nmodels","Social\nsupport","H&N\nsystem"),ordered = TRUE)
  
  # Plot
  heatmap <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = factor(.data[[cluster_var_name]]), y = label, fill = prop)) +
    geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(category), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#313695", mid = "#FFFFBF", high = "#A50026", midpoint = 0.5, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion within cluster", x = '', y = '', fill = 'Proportion within\ncluster') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 180, size = 5),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines")) 
    
  return(heatmap)
}

# Define the cluster variables
cluster_vars <- c("cluster_k2", "cluster_k3", "cluster_k4")
heatmaps_list <- purrr::map(cluster_vars, ~ generate_heatmap(dhs.seg_reform_rural, .x))

# To print each heatmap
purrr::walk(heatmaps_list, print)
```

### 2.3. Stacked bar (categorical)
```{r, fig.width=15, eval=FALSE}
# Prepare data
cat.var.rural <- cat.var[cat.var != "slum1"]

custom_labels <- c(
  "ed.lev.cat1" = "Women's edu",
  "wd.ownincome.cat" = "Women's deicision on own income",
  "jd.hlth.cat" = "Joined decision on women's health",
  "work.seasonal" = "Women's work",
  "water.cat" = "Water source",
  "partner.working" = "Partner's work",
  "auto.contra" = "Autonomy on contraceptive",
  "vehic.index" = "Vehicle ownership"
)

long_dt <- dhs.seg_rural %>%
  select(c(cat.var.rural, 'cluster_k2')) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cat.var.rural), names_to = "variable", values_to = "level")

cluster_size <- long_dt %>%
  group_by(cluster_k2, variable) %>%
  summarize(cluster_total = n(), .groups = 'drop')

agg_dt <- long_dt %>%
  group_by(cluster_k2, variable, level) %>%
  summarize(ct = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  left_join(cluster_size, by = c("cluster_k2", "variable")) %>% 
  mutate(pct = round((ct/cluster_total)*100, 2)) %>% 
  mutate(var.label = ifelse(variable %in% names(custom_labels), 
                            custom_labels[variable], 
                            variable))

agg_dt <- merge(agg_dt, var, by.x = "variable", by.y = "f.var.name")

agg_dt$category <- gsub("Woman and her past experiences", "Woman and her\npast experiences", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Household relationships", "Household\nrelationships", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Household economics and living conditions", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Health mental models", "Health mental\nmodels", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Social support", "Social\nsupport", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Human and natural systems", "H&N\nsystem", agg_dt$category)

agg_dt$category <- factor(agg_dt$category, 
                    levels = c("Woman and her\npast experiences", "Household\nrelationships", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", "Health mental\nmodels","Social\nsupport","H&N\nsystem"),ordered = TRUE)

agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Women's edu", "Women's edu", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Women's deicision on own income", "Women's deicision\non own income", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Joined decision on women's health", "Joined decision\non women's health", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Women's work", "Women's work", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Water source", "Water source", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Partner's work", "Partner's work", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Autonomy on contraceptive", "Autonomy on\ncontraceptive", agg_dt$var.label)
```

```{r, fig.height = 8, fig.width=15}
generate_stacked <- function(data, cluster_col) {

  long_dt <- data %>%
    select(all_of(cat.var.rural), .data[[cluster_col]]) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cat.var.rural), names_to = "variable", values_to = "level")

  cluster_size <- long_dt %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_col]], variable) %>%
    summarize(cluster_total = n(), .groups = 'drop')

  agg_dt <- long_dt %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_col]], variable, level) %>%
    summarize(ct = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(cluster_size, by = c(cluster_col, "variable")) %>% 
    mutate(pct = round((ct/cluster_total)*100, 2)) %>% 
    mutate(var.label = ifelse(variable %in% names(custom_labels), 
                            custom_labels[variable], 
                            variable))

agg_dt <- merge(agg_dt, var, by.x = "variable", by.y = "f.var.name")

agg_dt$category <- gsub("Woman and her past experiences", "Woman and her\npast experiences", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Household relationships", "Household\nrelationships", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Household economics and living conditions", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Health mental models", "Health mental\nmodels", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Social support", "Social\nsupport", agg_dt$category)
agg_dt$category <- gsub("Human and natural systems", "H&N\nsystem", agg_dt$category)

agg_dt$category <- factor(agg_dt$category, 
                    levels = c("Woman and her\npast experiences", "Household\nrelationships", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", "Health mental\nmodels","Social\nsupport","H&N\nsystem"),ordered = TRUE)

agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Women's edu", "Women's edu", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Women's deicision on own income", "Women's deicision\non own income", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Joined decision on women's health", "Joined decision\non women's health", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Women's work", "Women's work", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Water source", "Water source", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Partner's work", "Partner's work", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Autonomy on contraceptive", "Autonomy on\ncontraceptive", agg_dt$var.label)
agg_dt$var.label <- gsub("Vehicle ownership", "Vehicle\nownership", agg_dt$var.label)

# Define a manual color palette
my_colors <- c("0" = "#f9c696", "1" = "#FDB863" , "2" = "#BF5B17", "Full or partial autonomy" = "#ECEC26", "No control over" = "#FFFF99", "Not partnered" = "#F0027F", "Higher education" = "#386CB0", "Some eduction" = "#9cc2f4", "No eduction" = "#666666", "Not in union" = "#F0027F", "Not paid in cash or not working" = "#e0dcdc", "No" = "#666666","Yes" = "#D32F2F", "Not protected" = "#666666", "Open protected" = "#C7E9C0",  "Piped or borehole" = "#7FC97F", "Tank or packed" = "#259d25", "All  year" = "#563880", "Seasonal" = "#BEAED4", "Occassional" = "#e6dff1", "No work in the past 12 months" = "#666666", "Worked last 12 months" = "#8E24AA", "Worked last 7 days" = "#b590bf", "Not working or no partner"="#F0027F")

# Plot
stacked <- ggplot(agg_dt, aes(x=var.label, y=pct, fill=level)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack",width=0.5) + 
  facet_grid(category ~ .data[[cluster_col]], scales = "free_y", space = "free_x", switch = "y") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors) +
  labs(title = "Distribution within cluster", x = "", y = "Percentage of cluster total") +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Level")) +
  geom_text(aes(label=round(pct, 0)), position=position_stack(vjust=0.5), size=3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5), # Adjust size, angle for X-axis text
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"), # Adjust spacing between panels (if you have facets)
        plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "cm"), # Adjust overall plot margins
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6) )
  
  return(stacked)
}
```

### 2.5. Sankey plot
```{r}
seg.sankey <- dhs.seg_reform_rural %>% 
  select(cluster_k2, cluster_k3, cluster_k4) %>% 
  rename(k2 = cluster_k2, k3 = cluster_k3, k4 = cluster_k4)

links <- data.frame(source = character(), target = character(), value = character())

for(i in 1:(ncol(seg.sankey) - 1)){
  tmp <- seg.sankey %>%
    group_by_(.dots = names(seg.sankey)[c(i, i+1)]) %>%
    summarize(value = n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  tmp$source <- paste0(names(seg.sankey)[i], "_", tmp[[1]])
  tmp$target <- paste0(names(seg.sankey)[i+1], "_", tmp[[2]])
  
  links <- rbind(links, tmp[, c("source", "target", "value")])
}

# Create nodes data frame for Sankey diagram
nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(links$source, links$target)))

links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name) - 1
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name) - 1

# Create Sankey diagram
sankey <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes, Source = "IDsource",
                        Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
                        units = "TWh", fontSize = 12, nodeWidth = 30)

sankey
```

### 3.1. Model, statistics, distribution
```{r,eval=FALSE}
sink("round4_urban.txt")
f <- cbind(ed.lev.cat1,early.cohab.19, marr.cohab, media.sum.2plus, husb.ed.mtprim, wd.ownincome.cat, highestyearsedinHH.7plus, num.under15.2plus, work.seasonal, water.cat, wealth.index.ur.ord, hh.watpur.appr, hh.toilet.flush, med.distance, disc.fp.yn, insurance.cov.cat1, slum1, vehic.index, hh.land)~1

urban_class_comp <- data.frame('k' = 2:4, 'BIC' = numeric(3), 'AIC' = numeric(3), 'Chisq' = numeric(3), 'llh' = numeric(3), 'iter' = numeric(3))
urban_pred_class <- list()

lca_results <- list()
for (i in 1:3) {
  print(i)
  cat("\nRunning model with", i + 1, "classes...\n")
  res <- tryCatch({
    poLCA(f, dhs.seg_reform_urban, nclass = (i + 1), maxiter = 5000, tol = 1e-7, nrep = 50, verbose = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("An error occurred: ", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })

  lca_results[[i]] <- res
  
  if (is.null(res)) {
    cat("The poLCA function did not return results for", i + 1, "classes.\n")
    urban_class_comp[urban_class_comp$k == (i + 1), ] <- c((i + 1), NA, NA, NA, NA, NA)
    next
  }

  urban_class_comp[urban_class_comp$k == (i + 1), ] <- c((i + 1), res$bic %||% NA, res$aic %||% NA, res$Chisq %||% NA, res$llik %||% NA, res$numiter %||% NA)

  if (!is.null(res$predclass)) {
    dhs.seg_urban4$cluster <- res$predclass
    dhs.seg_reform_urban$cluster <- res$predclass
    names(dhs.seg_urban4)[names(dhs.seg_urban4)=='cluster'] <- paste0('cluster_k',(i+1))
    names(dhs.seg_reform_urban)[names(dhs.seg_reform_urban)=='cluster'] <- paste0('cluster_k',(i+1))
  } else {
    warning("Model with", i + 1, "classes did not return class memberships.")
  }
}

sink()
print(urban_class_comp)  
```

### 3.2. Heatmap (binary)
```{r}
# Define function
generate_heatmap <- function(data, cluster_var_name) {
  
  data_modified <- data %>%
    select(c(bin.var), .data[[cluster_var_name]]) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(bin.var), ~ifelse(. == 2, 1, 0), .names = "prop_{.col}")) %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_var_name]]) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("prop_"), mean))
  
  custom_labels <- c(
  "marr.cohab" = "With partner",
  "early.cohab.19" = "Early marriage or cohabitation",
  "media.sum.2plus" = "Use 2+ media sources",
  "num.under15.2plus" = "With 2+ children U15",
  "hh.kidwom.rat.2plus" = "Ratio of U5 to women >=2",
  "husb.ed.mtprim" = "Partner edu more than primary",
  "highestyearsedinHH.7plus" = "7+ years of edu for HH",
  "hh.watpur.appr" = "Use water purify method",
  "hh.toilet.flush" = "Use flush toilet",
  "med.distance" = "Distance is a big problem",
  "med.alone" = "Going alone is a big problem",
  "med.permis" = "Getting permision is a big problem",
  "disc.fp.yn" = "Discuss FP with someone",
  "insurance.cov.cat1" = "Coverged by EPM insurance",
  "hh.land" = "Own land for agriculture"
)
  
  df_long <- data_modified %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("prop_"), names_to = "var.label", values_to = "prop") %>%
    mutate(var.label = str_remove(var.label, "prop_"),
           label = ifelse(var.label %in% names(custom_labels), custom_labels[var.label], var.label),
           label_percent = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1))
  df_long <- merge(df_long, var, by.x = "var.label", by.y = "f.var.name")
  
  df_long$category <- gsub("Woman and her past experiences", "Woman and her\npast experiences", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Household relationships", "Household\nrelationships", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Household economics and living conditions", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Health mental models", "Health mental\nmodels", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Social support", "Social\nsupport", df_long$category)
  df_long$category <- gsub("Human and natural systems", "H&N\nsystem", df_long$category)

  df_long$category <- factor(df_long$category, 
                    levels = c("Woman and her\npast experiences", "Household\nrelationships", "HH econ &\nliving cond.", "Health mental\nmodels","Social\nsupport","H&N\nsystem"),ordered = TRUE)
  
  # Plot
  heatmap <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = factor(.data[[cluster_var_name]]), y = label, fill = prop)) +
    geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(category), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#313695", mid = "#FFFFBF", high = "#A50026", midpoint = 0.5, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion within cluster", x = '', y = '', fill = 'Proportion within\ncluster') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 180, size = 5),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines")) 
    
  return(heatmap)
}

# Define the cluster variables
cluster_vars <- c("cluster_k2", "cluster_k3", "cluster_k4")
heatmaps_list <- purrr::map(cluster_vars, ~ generate_heatmap(dhs.seg_reform_urban, .x))

# To print each heatmap
purrr::walk(heatmaps_list, print)
```

```{r}
seg.sankey.ur <- dhs.seg_reform_urban %>% 
  select(cluster_k2, cluster_k3, cluster_k4) %>% 
  rename(k2 = cluster_k2, k3 = cluster_k3, k4 = cluster_k4)

links <- data.frame(source = character(), target = character(), value = character())

for(i in 1:(ncol(seg.sankey.ur) - 1)){
  tmp <- seg.sankey.ur %>%
    group_by_(.dots = names(seg.sankey.ur)[c(i, i+1)]) %>%
    summarize(value = n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  tmp$source <- paste0(names(seg.sankey.ur)[i], "_", tmp[[1]])
  tmp$target <- paste0(names(seg.sankey.ur)[i+1], "_", tmp[[2]])
  
  links <- rbind(links, tmp[, c("source", "target", "value")])
}

# Create nodes data frame for Sankey diagram
nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(links$source, links$target)))

links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name) - 1
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name) - 1

# Create Sankey diagram
sankey <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes, Source = "IDsource",
                        Target = "IDtarget", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
                        units = "TWh", fontSize = 12, nodeWidth = 30)

sankey
```
